text:
bob-release: Heads up - premerge eval suite flagged a quality regression on the summarizer change. failing metric: ROUGE-L drop 4.2% vs baseline, hallucination rate up 3.8% (sample size 2.1k). link: https://redwood.internal/evals/4319876540
carlos-qa: looking at the diffs now. most regressions concentrated on 'user_shortform' prompt group, particularly edge-case truncation. logs attached.
alice-eng: thanks. can we do a targeted pin for the EU route while we investigate? NA canary still looks fine but shrink sample size.
diane-prod: request: we need a decision within the 1h change window or we autosuspend. What's the operational impact of pausing EU?
elena-sre: pausing EU route reduces traffic ~6% and preserves latency SLOs. we can route EU->stable-2026-03-15 model by config pin; rollforward later if fix is validated.
deploybot: preflight-eval: check FAILED for change 2026-03-20T14:02Z. failing_tests: prompt-suite:user_shortform, prompt-suite:faq-summarize. severity: medium. auto-tags: eval-regression
carlos-qa: quick stat: per-prompt breakdown shows the largest error on prompts with nested bullets. sample snippet: ```User: summarize bullets -> got repeated items```
qa-bot: alert: regression delta +3.8% > threshold 2.5% for user_shortform. recommended action: hold or partial pin.
bob-release: proposed plan: 1) pin EU route to stable-2026-03-15 (immediate) 2) reduce NA canary from 10%->3% and continue smoke for 2h 3) triage team reproduces top 20 failures and rolls patch or config fallback by EOD
alice-eng: ack. I can cut the rollback PR for the quant change and also prepare a partial prompt-fix that strips nested bullets. will open a PR and link in 5m.
diane-prod: @alice-eng and @carlos-qa please mark tickets with P0 if production visible. also update release notes: "Canary slowed; EU pinned due to eval regression."
elena-sre: I'll apply the route pin in infra and put a tombstone alert. command: `redwood route pin --region eu --to stable-2026-03-15 --by deploybot`
deploybot: action: route pin queued. expected propagation 90s. ticket: RB-4382.
carlos-qa: follow-up: running targeted replay on user_shortform with baseline vs candidate, will post a small CSV with failing ids.
bob-release: decision: implement partial pin and continue reduced canary in NA. if NA shows >1.5% additional regression in next 2h we rollback fully. assigning: alice-eng (fix PR), carlos-qa (repro list), elena-sre (pin + monitoring).
alice-eng: starting PR now. cc @diane-prod
diane-prod: thanks. logging decision in product tracker and emailing stakeholders. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: note: scheduled re-eval at +30m and +90m. will post summary.
deploybot: route pin successful. EU traffic now on stable-2026-03-15. propagation: 83s.
carlos-qa: posted repro CSV: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/4319876540/repros.csv - 18 unique failure cases, attaching short notes.
bob-release: closing the thread for now. re-open if any new regressions surface.
